dsh-any-background README · dsh-any-background：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A **DeepSeek Harness** appearance plugin: custom theme color, background wallpaper (image / video / algorithmically generated), and per-surface opacity & blur control. Compatible with **DSH `0.2.0-rc.1` through `0.2.2-alpha.2` — and every host release above it**.

dsh-any-background README · Color & theme：- **PS-style color wheel** — Hue on the ring, saturation and lightness in the inscribed square; generates 30+ CSS design tokens live.
- **Precise HSL / RGB input** — Numeric entry, bidirectionally synced with the wheel.
- **Smart extraction / eyedropper** — One click derives a theme color from the wallpaper (sampling the visible area and discarding gray, near-black and near-white), or hover any pixel to pick it. Video wallpapers contribute an auto-captured frame. All client-side.
- **Forced light / dark scheme** — Light, dark or auto. In auto the surface and font direction follow the accent color's lightness (dark pick → light text), falling back to the wallpaper's brightness when no accent is set.
- **Theme export / import** — A self-contained `dsh-any-theme.json` (config + wallpaper + the whole rotation pool) that restores anywhere.
- **Presets & profiles** — Six one-click presets plus named profiles that can be renamed and duplicated; deleting asks for confirmation twice.

dsh-any-background README · Background & wallpaper：- **Image wallpaper** — Upload any image as the background.
- **Video wallpaper** — Muted, looping, survives refreshes (persisted on disk + HTTP Range streaming), with one frame captured for the preview, color extraction and position editing.
- **Position editor & layout modes** — Drag to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom, one-click reset; Fit / Fill / Stretch / Tile / Center. Image and video placements are stored separately and never overwrite each other.
- **Generated backgrounds** — Mesh gradient, Shader or geometric patterns, with adjustable spread and intensity and a lockable seed.
- **Wallpaper rotation** — Build a pool with the thumbnail picker and rotate by shuffle or order, on every refresh / hourly / daily / weekly; the cadence advances while the page stays open, not only on reload.
- **Day / night switch** — A day profile and a night profile, switched on a fixed schedule or by following the OS dark mode.

dsh-any-background README · Per-surface opacity & blur：- **Eleven parts, each with its own slider pair** — main background, sidebar, card panels, input & controls, settings panel, conversation frame, trajectory view, right sidebar (or bettersidebar), produced / highlighted content, header popovers, and the header bar.
- **The slider IS the frost amount, and 0 means no frost** — including over the host's own default menu frost. Every part still **defaults to 30px**, so a stock install keeps the frosted look.
- **Opacity re-scopes the host's own token** — it never stacks a second color over the original, so the wallpaper shows through the content.
- **Produced / highlighted content shares one slider** — code blocks (with their language banner), inline `code` chips and produced chips move together.
- **Right sidebar / bettersidebar: one pair, two identities** — without dsh-better-sidebar it drives the official right sidebar; with it installed the same pair takes over that plugin's bottom workbench panel (the official sidebar keeps responding too).
- **On the Windows desktop shell it also drives the caption band** — the sidebar pair paints the segment directly above the sidebar, and th

dsh-any-background README · Interface parts：- **Sidebar "Theme" page (dual mode)** — The same five pages (Color / Interface / Font / Background / Profiles) register into the official right sidebar's guide page or into dsh-better-sidebar's sidebar, sharing one state with the settings panel, so a change anywhere shows everywhere. On a host without that extension point nothing is registered, silently.
- **Conversation view cards** — The message list is wrapped in a translucent card automatically, and the trajectory page adjusts as a whole page.
- **Header popovers and the header bar are separately adjustable** — the Agent Team panel, the background-job list, the session-header dropdowns, and the title / view-tab row at the top of a session each have their own opacity + blur pair.
- **Custom font** — Upload a ttf / otf / woff / woff2 (up to 100 MB) and apply it across the interface; code blocks stay monospace. Can be disabled or removed at any time.
- **Per-part text outline** — The same surface groups as the interface page, each with its own `-webkit-text-stroke` (0–4px, 0 = off) in auto-contrast / gray / black / white / accent / custom. Code blocks, inline `code`, icons and the host'

dsh-any-background README · General：- **File-based persistence** — Everything is stored under `~/.dsh/.dsh-any-background-data/`, not in `localStorage`.
- **Bilingual UI** — Full Chinese / English interface following the host's locale.
- **Theme watchdog** — Re-asserts the custom theme if the host resets it.

dsh-any-background README · v0.4.2 (dsh-better-display's summary bar compatibility · fixes issue #32)：- **The summary bar is no longer hollowed out.** Its plate reads the token our 「主界面」 opacity owns, so at 0 the conversation streamed straight through it. When [dsh-better-display](https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-better-display) is detected the band is pinned at a **20% plate + 30px frost** — no slider moves it, the color still follows the theme — and the three separate bars merge into one box with the bottom corners rounded.
- **Third-party surface self-check + a compatibility switch.** At boot the plugin scans other plugins' stylesheets and names in the console whose surface reads a token this plugin owns: registered ones get protected automatically, unregistered ones log a note inviting that line to be reported. A card at the bottom of the Interface page switches the whole pin sheet off, leaving the other plugin to paint its own surfaces.
- **Issue #32 fixed.** The frosted sidebar column is lifted to `z-index:1`, so a tooltip overhanging the sidebar's right edge stays crisp; the modal exemption now resets `z-index` and `isolation` together.

dsh-any-background README · Compatibility：- **[`dsh web`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): `0.2.0-rc.1` ~ `0.2.2-alpha.2`, and everything above it.** The gate names each build that was checked and then closes with an uncapped `>=0.2.0-rc.1`. That umbrella is deliberate: the host enforces exactly this peer list — a release it does not name is disabled before a single module is imported — so a range that runs out is a wall in front of a plugin that would have kept working. (More precisely: the host's `app-boot` `unmetRequirements` reads `engines.dsh` alone when that field is present and ignores peerDependencies, so all four places must say the same thing but `engines.dsh` is what actually decides whether the plugin loads.)
- **How an unseen build runs**: it gets the closest verified set of facts plus a log line saying how far from `exact` that is. The worst a stale fact can cost is one slider no longer fading a surface the host has since moved; a version check that failed closed would cost the whole plugin.
- **Verified builds** (`dsh.compatibility.dshReleases`):

dsh-any-background README · Compatibility：- **Facts are isolated per release**: the host release is resolved on the Node half and handed down through the `read` RPC; styling and logic only ask the adapter questions (who owns this surface, which layer carries the frost, which token fades a menu) and never compare version strings. Supporting a new host means adding one version folder and registering it.
- **A restart is still needed after installing or updating the plugin**: the compatibility check runs while the profile is composed, not when the plugin is updated. Features that depend on a specific host structure (the right sidebar's panel blur, the official sidebar's "Theme" card) enable themselves only where that structure exists; everything else behaves identically across the range.
- **The `0.1.5` / `0.1.6` / `0.1.7` era is out of the supported range**: those fact folders assert things nothing re-checks any more, and a table nobody verifies is worse than no table. An older host is now refused at composition rather than quietly restyled by the wrong adapter.

dsh-any-background README · Permissions, side effects & boundaries：- **Integration form**: an official Profile Bundle — `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch: ./cordis.patch.yml` (a loader insert layer) and the repository ships ready-to-use prebuilt artifacts (`lib/index.js`, `lib/client.js`). No install scripts, no postinstall, no native binaries, no build step at install time.
- **Filesystem**: the server half reads and writes only inside `<dsh home>/.dsh-any-background-data/` (config, wallpaper, rotation pool, video, font) and touches nothing outside it; config writes are atomic (temp file + rename). These files live on the real disk, so they are **outside generation restore — it neither captures nor rolls them back**; deleting the directory is a full plugin reset.
- **Network**: exactly one outbound fetch, and only when the user pastes an http/https image or video URL and presses Apply. No telemetry, no other external calls.
- **Shell / native**: none. No `child_process`, no native modules, no dynamically downloaded binaries.

dsh-any-background（DSH 插件，网页客户端）：为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面定制主题外观。插件注册自定义配色并注入设置与侧边栏页面；支持图片、视频和程序生成壁纸，编辑位置和布局，调整界面区域透明度、模糊与文字描边，并管理字体、配置导入导出、预设、轮换及昼夜外观。适合希望个性化 DSH 网页工作区的用户。无需 API 密钥或外部账号；配置和媒体保存在本机 DSH 数据目录。
dsh-any-background customizes DSH web themes with wallpapers, panel opacity and blur, fonts, profiles, and scheduled background rotation. No API key is needed; settings and media are stored locally.
